Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderLanguages.doubleUnary_subst.{u_1, u_2} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (s : L.Functions 1) :
  ((s.apply₁ (s.apply₁ (FirstOrder.Language.var 0))).subst fun i =>
      if i = 0 then s.apply₁ (FirstOrder.Language.var 1) else FirstOrder.Language.var i) =
    s.apply₁ (s.apply₁ (s.apply₁ (FirstOrder.Language.var 1)))
